notes.title: ⚓ All Will Fall Major Demo Update - Tiny Teams Event
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455265/f5c92dcef2a7b7df1a25ee9f378d8fe3f511ac82.png"]
Hello, Stranded Survivor! ⚓
As part of the Tiny Teams Event starting today, a new update has been released for the All Will Fall Demo with plenty of improvements and new content, all thanks to our community’s feedback from the previous demo! A big thank you and shoutout to everyone who has been playing All Will Fall and shared your thoughts so far!



What’s new in today’s Demo Update:


New Sea Access Mechanic
Buildings that interact with water, like Fishing Huts and Wood Catchers, now reserve space along the shoreline. If their areas overlap, production efficiency is reduced. This strategic drawback has allowed us to buff buildings that generate infinite resources.


Multi-Selection for Buildings
You can now hold Shift and click to select multiple buildings, making it easier to reposition them all at once. Connected buildings can also be group-selected by using a hotkey!


Water Wheel Rework
Water Wheels no longer need to be built on the sea. Instead, it now generates power using rain.


Roof Rainflow System
Roofs now redirect rainfall, which can boost the efficiency of Rain Catchers and Water Wheels placed below.


Electricity Overhaul
Electricity now behaves like other resources. It can be stored using newly added batteries, enabling better energy management across your settlement.


Improved Physics System
Buildings now connect more realistically through voxel walls instead of corners. Horizontal connections are much weaker, so using vertical columns and arc-bridge designs is now more beneficial.


Clearer UI for Production Bonuses
Input, Output, and Production Time now have clearly colored indicators in the UI—making affected building stat changes easier to understand at a glance.


Smarter Citizens & Boats
Citizens and boats will now remember their tasks even when buildings change. They also adapt to in-progress resource transfers to avoid inefficiencies or failed deliveries.


And Many More Improvements:
Partial Map Randomizations

Trees

Animated scene transitions

Faster game startup

Optimized water rendering

Better building placement/removal performance

Physics optimization



We also host playtests before we release updates on Steam, where we invite you on our Discord to play it early and share your feedback! So make sure to join the Discord if you’re interested!



And lastly, we’re working on a launch roadmap, which will give you a better idea of what’s planned beyond the demo and into launch, so stay tuned for more news.



Thank you for your continued support on All Will Fall, we‘re excited to hear your thoughts on this demo update!

notes.title: ⚓ Patch Log #Version-0.7.0a12
notes.notes:
Hello, Stranded Survivours! ⚓

We have coded-up some performance improvements and these changes are now live for playtesting. Let us know how your city looks and if these changes have improved performance for you!

Version-0.7.0a11

 Fix water shader to be compatible with early Direct X 11 versions
 Change default water compute resolution to 512, add options to switch even lower or higher
 Only update water wave frequency spectrums when needed - reduces GPU load when weather is not changing
 Add approximate shadow rendering system which renders boxes instead of whole objects at a distance. Add setting for it
 Smooth-edged weather segment UI borders for smoother movement
 Enable SRP batcher and instanced drawing by default
 Enable small object culling. Make wooden wind turbine blades immune to small object culling

Version-0.7.0a12

 When bug report filesize is too large only include the last save file to the report instead of whole playthrough
 Optimize citizen congestion calculations - should improve performance with cities with a lot of walking citizens
 Don't set moss values when renderable is above water - improves renderer batching, especially for cities way above water
 Water compute is always synchronized - should fix water stuttering from a11 update
 Renderable shadows now also support using child renderers as proxy box providers - some shadowcasters now have more accurate shadow proxies

Version-0.7.0a14

 Disable Resident Drawer for Direct3D feature level 11.0 cards
 Optimize water to use less GPU for computing
 Fixed resources not spawning after loading a save

notes.notes:
Hello, Stranded Survivours! ⚓

Thanks to your feedback and endless building, we have ANOTHER update for you. 
We've fixed a range of bugs and made major improvements. Don't forget, if you haven't tried it out yourself, you can join the playtest right now.

Take a look at the list below for more information!


 Fix collapse button menu position scaling - it should now be in correct position for all resolutions
 Enable storm FX for main menu
 Special main menu weather with milder and faster changing weather
 Fire new event sound only if it's actually new - fixes currently active event sounds replaying all at once on undo
 Settings and all other game panels try to fit into the screen. One can no longer get their game soft locked by switching to too low resolution
 Prevent control binding error when bind is not completed by switching scenes
 Some hotkeys are no longer triggered when writing text. Fixes height meter activating and making the city invisible again while trying to report bugs about invisible city
 Reduced most of the icon size to 256px which scales UI atlas down to 4k instead of 8k. Might reduce crashes for some players and will improve performance a bit
 Fix wrong food icon in citizen needs UI
 Fixed a bug where citizens were trying to enter deconstructed buildings
 Add option to disable drawing of camera pivot cube
 Add option to disable changing time speed during night/day cycle
 Add advanced graphics settings
 Make game window resizable
 Update preloaded shaders
